companies.name: Compound
companies.funding_notes: Compound Labs (compound.finance), San Francisco; builder of the Compound DeFi lending/interest-rate protocol. $8.2M seed in May 2018 (SEC Form D shows $8,230,001; investors a16z, Polychain, Bain Capital Ventures, plus Transmedia, Abstract, Danhua, Coinbase) and a $25M Series A in Nov 2019 led by a16z crypto with Paradigm, Bain Capital Ventures and Polychain (reported ~$90M valuation). Total equity about $33.2M. Excludes the COMP governance token, which is not an equity raise. No later priced equity round found.

companies.name: Pilot
companies.description: Pilot offers reliable accounting, CFO, and tax services to startups and small businesses, partnering with thousands to drive sustainable growth and help streamline operations.
companies.website_source: company website (domain verified against name and accelerator description)
companies.funding_notes: Pilot (pilot.com), San Francisco; accounting, tax and CFO services for startups and SMBs, founded 2017 by Waseem Daher, Jeff Arnold and Jessica McKellar. Series A $15M (Mar 2018, Index); Series B $40M (Apr 2019, Index lead with Stripe, $355M valuation; TechCrunch put the total raised at about $60M at that point, so roughly $5M of earlier funding is undisclosed); Series C $60M led by Sequoia (Jan 2021), expanded in Mar 2021 to $100M total with Bezos Expeditions and Whale Rock at a $1.2B valuation. Total equity is approximate: about $160M (about $60M through Series B plus the $100M Series C). Trackers show about $218-222M, but no reputable source backs that figure, so it is not used. No round after 2021 found.

companies.name: Cognition AI
companies.funding_notes: Cognition (cognition.ai, now cognition.com), San Francisco; maker of the Devin AI software engineer, founded 2023-24 by Scott Wu and team. $21M Series A led by Founders Fund (Mar 2024, about $350M valuation); $175M led by Founders Fund at $2B (Apr 2024, per The Information/WSJ); a March 2025 round led by 8VC with Lux at nearly $4B (Bloomberg says 'hundreds of millions', no exact public figure); $400M+ led by Founders Fund at $10.2B post (Sep 2025); $1B+ Series D at $26B led by Lux, General Catalyst and 8VC (May 2026); and a $2B+ Series E at $48B led by a16z and Accel (Sep 8, 2026). The stage names for the 2024-2025 growth rounds are not public. The total is a floor: at least $3.596B (sum of disclosed amounts, several stated as 'over'), not counting the undisclosed March 2025 amount. Acquired Windsurf in July 2025.

companies.name: Goodfire
companies.description: Understand and intelligently design your AI
companies.funding_notes: Goodfire (goodfire.ai / goodfire.com), San Francisco; an AI interpretability research lab and public benefit corporation (CEO Eric Ho) that incubated at South Park Commons. Rounds: $7M seed led by Lightspeed (Aug 2024), $50M Series A led by Menlo Ventures with Anthropic participating (Apr 2025), and $150M Series B led by B Capital at a $1.25B valuation (Feb 2026). Total equity is $207M (sum of the three rounds; the company says it is backed by 'over $200M').

companies.name: Socket
companies.website_source: company website (domain verified against name and accelerator description)
companies.funding_notes: Socket (socket.dev, the domain given in the input), San Francisco; software supply-chain security company founded in 2020 by Feross Aboukhadijeh. Rounds: $4.6M Series Seed (May 2022; mostly angels plus Unusual Ventures, Village Global and South Park Commons), $20M Series A led by a16z (Aug 2023), $40M Series B led by Abstract Ventures (Oct 2024), and $60M Series C led by Thrive Capital at a $1B valuation (May 2026). Total equity is $124.6M by sum of rounds; the company describes it as about $125M.

companies.name: Muon Space
companies.description: Muon Space designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations, delivering mission-critical Earth data for climate, security, and more, making space smarter and our world safer.
companies.website_source: company website (domain verified against name and accelerator description)
companies.funding_notes: Muon Space (muonspace.com, the domain given in the input), Mountain View, CA; builds LEO satellite constellations and was founded in 2021 (CEO Jonny Dyer). Rounds: $10M seed led by Costanoa (Oct 2021), $25M Series A led by Radical Ventures (Aug 2022), $56.7M Series B led by Activate Capital (Aug 2024), $89.5M Series B1 led by Congruent (Jun 2025; only $44.5M of it is equity, the other $45M is credit facilities and is excluded), and $250M Series C led by Eclipse (Aug 2026). The company says total equity is 'more than $386M', which matches the sum of the sourced equity rounds. Acquired Starlight Engines (propulsion) in 2025.

companies.name: Vanta
companies.website_source: company website (domain verified against name and accelerator description)
companies.funding_notes: Vanta (vanta.com, the domain given in the input), San Francisco; security and compliance automation company founded in 2018 by Christina Cacioppo. Rounds: $50M Series A led by Sequoia (May 2021, about $500M valuation), $110M Series B led by Craft Ventures (Jun 2022, $1.6B), $150M Series C led by Sequoia (Jul 2024, $2.45B), and $150M Series D led by Wellington Management (Jul 2025, $4.15B). SecurityWeek reports $504M raised since 2021, which is the figure used here. The four disclosed rounds add up to only $460M, so about $44M is not itemized publicly. Earlier seed/Y Combinator funding amounts are not public. No round after Jul 2025 found as of Oct 2026.

companies.name: Imbue
companies.description: Imbue builds AI systems that reason, powering smart agents to safely handle complex tasks and reimagine personal computing as an empowering tool in our everyday lives.
companies.funding_notes: Imbue (imbue.com, formerly Generally Intelligent), San Francisco; an AI lab building reasoning agents, CEO Kanjun Qiu. Came out of stealth in Oct 2022 with $20M of initial funding (round type not stated; over $100M more was committed through options and milestones). Raised a $200M Series B at a valuation over $1B in Sep 2023 (Astera Institute, NVIDIA and others; TechCrunch put the total at $220M), then a $12M follow-on from Amazon's Alexa Fund and Eric Schmidt in Oct 2023. Total is about $232M (TechCrunch's $220M plus $12M; Imbue itself says 'over $210M'). No lead investor was publicly named for the Series B. No round after 2023 found.

companies.name: Planetscale
companies.funding_notes: PlanetScale (planetscale.com), San Francisco area; serverless MySQL/Vitess database company founded in 2018 by Jitendra Vaidya and Sugu Sougoumarane. Rounds: $3M seed (2018, per TechCrunch; investors not itemized, though SignalFire was an existing investor by the Series A), $22M Series A led by a16z (May 2019), $30M Series B led by Insight Partners (Jun 2021), and $50M Series C led by Kleiner Perkins (Nov 2021). Total is $105M, per the Series C release, which matches the sum of the rounds. No priced round after 2021 found.

companies.name: Titan
companies.website_source: company website (domain verified against name and accelerator description)
companies.funding_notes: Titan (titan.com, the domain given in the input), New York; app-based wealth and investment management company founded in 2017-18 by Clayton Gardner, Joe Percoco and Max Bernardy. Rounds: $12.5M Series A led by General Catalyst (Feb 2021; total at that point $16M, so about $3.5M of earlier funding came before it, which Contrary Research describes as a $2.5M seed in Oct 2018) and $58M Series B led by a16z at a $450M valuation (Jul 2021). TechCrunch put the total at $75M. Contrary Research reports an unannounced ~$100M Series C in Jan 2023 at about $1B, with investors undisclosed. No press release or major outlet confirms it, so it is not counted in the round field or the total. Titan settled SEC charges over crypto performance marketing in 2023.
